entities.summary: Abdel Aziz Boukar Moussa is a Chadian-born Angolan basketball center. He is a former member of the Angola national basketball team, and competed for Angola at the 2004 Summer Olympics, 2005 African Championship, 2006 Lusophony Games and 2006 FIBA World Championship. He stands 6 ft 8 in (2.03 m).
